crossRefs.note: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever:
the Spirit of truth, whom the world can’t receive; for it doesn’t see him and doesn’t know him. You know him, for he…
But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things, and will remind…
Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is to your advantage that I go away, for if I don’t go away, the Counselor won’t…
However when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself…
He will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine, and will declare it to you.
Behold, I send out the promise of my Father on you. But wait in the city of Jerusalem until you are clothed with power…
Being therefore exalted by the right hand of God, and having received from the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit…
Therefore Jesus said to them, “If God were your father, you would love me, for I came out and have come from God. For I…
He showed me a river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb,
He will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine, and will declare it to you.
All things that the Father has are mine; therefore I said that he takes of mine and will declare it to you.
This Jesus God raised up, to which we all are witnesses.
Being therefore exalted by the right hand of God, and having received from the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit…
We are his witnesses of these things; and so also is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him.”
God, who knows the heart, testified about them, giving them the Holy Spirit, just like he did to us.
even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you:
God also testifying with them, both by signs and wonders, by various works of power and by gifts of the Holy Spirit…
This is he who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ; not with the water only, but with the water and the blood. It is…

translations.web: “When the Counselor has come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me.
translations.bsb: When the Advocate comes, whom I will send to you from the Father—the Spirit of truth who proceeds from the Father—He will testify about Me.
translations.kjv: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall testify of me:
translations.asv: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall bear witness of me:
